nodes.text: 'You have been looking at the bell,' Mara says. 'Most strangers do. The villagers try not to.'

choices.text: The wolf is dead. The track is clear.
Tell me again where to look.
I will take the candle to the chapel.

nodes.text: 'A wolf walks the north track in daylight. That is trouble enough for one village.' She turns the candle over. 'Will you help?'
'North, past the last roof. Come back while there is still light.'
'The north track. You will know the place by the red thread.'
She leaves the gate ajar. Beyond it, the chapel stair descends into darkness.
'Set it where you think it belongs,' she says. 'That will be enough.'
